# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 17 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 17
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. What I have shared with you so far on these subjects has been enough — I have kept it simple, and the understanding I carry in these areas comes from faith. But because I love you, I want to try, briefly, to touch on the things that relate to our salvation. In all of this, let us live lives worthy of the Lord.
2. Now I move to another teaching — a different kind of instruction. There are two ways of teaching and two kinds of power: the way of light and the way of darkness. The gap between them is immense. Over the way of light, God has stationed his radiant angels; over the way of darkness, Satan's angels.
3. The Lord of the way of light is the eternal Lord — before all the ages and through all the ages to come. The lord of the way of darkness is the ruler of this present lawless age.
